purpose: v029 decel overrun spark pop activation (Row 100 in ECM 44605) and low-throttle cruising stutter elimination (+3.0% MAF scaling at 0.90V-1.20V in ECM 12163)

tune.status: Candidate prepared for owner entry and flash

changes_since_previous_run: Relative to v028: populated Row 4 (100 ECT) in [ECM] 44605 with target decel retard (-2 deg at 3k, -4 deg at 4-6k RPM) to activate overrun pops at normal operating ECT (175-195F); scaled airflow in [ECM] 12163 by +3.0% across 0.90V to 1.20V (0.898V 0.1425->0.1468, 1.000V 0.1729->0.1781, 1.100V 0.2066->0.2128, 1.200V 0.2734->0.2816 lb/min) to center cruising fuel trims at 0.0% and eliminate light-throttle cruising stutter. All v028 dashpot decay and DFCO settings preserved.

profile.filename: profiles/2004 Focus SVT - V023 Idle Spark Trial.Channels.xml
profile.status: All 18 requested channels required; paired with SCG-1 wideband lambda

conditions.accessories: Standard driving; A/C OFF during pulls

planned_actions: Stage A: Steady light-throttle cruising evaluation. Hold steady cruise (35-45 mph in 3rd/4th gear, 2,000-2,500 RPM, 2-5% pedal) for 15-20 seconds. Verify that the previous low-throttle stutter/hesitation is completely smoothed out and STFT hovers around 0.0%.

Stage B: Overrun decel pop evaluation. Perform in-gear deceleration from 4,500-5,000 RPM down to 2,500 RPM in 2nd or 3rd gear. Verify that crisp, audible exhaust pops/burble occur during the 1.25s delay window before DFCO cut.
Stage C: Rolling stop idle verification. Coast down to 0 mph in neutral/clutch-in; re-verify that the engine glides smoothly into settled 950 RPM idle without hanging or dipping.
Stage D: Boost pull check (optional). Perform a moderate boost pull up to ~5,500-6,000 RPM if road conditions permit, confirming lambda remains safely in the 0.72-0.75 range.
stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.80 (> 11.7 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
Boost spike > 15.5 psi (approaching 16 psi SCG-1 cut)
Engine stall or severe undershoot (< 700 RPM) on clutch-in
Fuel rail pressure collapse (< 35 psi differential)
